normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to feed the private _transfer arithmetic and max-transaction check, so it normalizes into the core transfer function.
The from parameter is a local binding of the caller/transfer origin inside _transfer and carries no independent semantics.
The to parameter is only meaningful through _transfer's pair, bot and cooldown logic and should be folded into that core function.
This local is the swap input computed in _transfer and immediately consumed by the external swap operation.
This local rate value is derived inside the reflection math and only used to scale amounts in _transferStandard.
